blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Former Sen. Antonio Trillanes IV will no longer be presented as witness by the prosecution panel for Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, according to Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro said. The lead public prosecutor made the announcement during the trial on Thursday, informing the Senate impeachment court that they have finally decided to refrain from presenting Trillanes. READ: Trillanes may be next witness in Duterte impeachment trial on Sept. 30 “The prosecution has finally decided not to present former Senator Sonny Trillanes.
